study type: Single-centre prospective, single-blinded, randomized controlled trial
cohort: 98 primigravid women at the antenatal outpatient clinic of a secondary healthcare institution
finding: Antepartum breathing exercises during labour can facilitate spontaneous vaginal birth, shorten the duration of labour, and reduce the need for operative interference.
mod_finding: The requirement for augmentation of labour was minimal and there was a reduction in the rate of caesarean deliveries in the intervention group.
